[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "The Last Time I Lied" by Riley Sager: A woman returns to a summer camp where her friends disappeared 15 years earlier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. "The Couple Next Door" by Shari Lapena: A couple's baby goes missing, revealing secrets they've been hiding.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. "The Wife Between Us" by Greer Hendricks and Sarah Pekkanen: A domestic thriller about a marriage that's not what it seems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. "The Stranger Diaries" by Elly Griffiths: A writer of horror stories becomes embroiled in a real-life murder mystery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. "The 7 1/2 Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle" by Stuart Turton: A mind-bending murder mystery with a cycle of murder and rebirth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. "The Poison Tree" by Erin Kelly: A dark thriller about a family dealing with past tragedy.
